messages:
Tess (CSM): flagged: Glenview activity cratered after demo handoff. dashboard shows 90% drop in inference calls since Friday. anyone tracking?
Ibrahim (AE): I noticed too. procurement looped in a new ML lead (Liam) last week — they said they were validating latency and cost against a competitor called VectorFlow.
Kai (Solutions Eng): quick check: any config changes on our side around the 11/21 cutoff? model swaps, quantization, billing tier changes?
Tess (CSM): not from CSM side. I dug into audit logs: last deploy was a minor weights patch on 11/20. no config flips.
billing-bot: invoice GLVW-2025-11 generated 2025-11-22 — status: unpaid. reminder scheduled.
Ibrahim (AE): Liam mentioned VectorFlow had a prefetch cache demo that reduced token usage in their test. Glenview cares a lot about long-doc folding cost.
Priya (Glenview): quick note from our side: main blocker is procurement asking for a cost comparison + security diagram. also seeing occasional 500s on our last integration tests.
Kai (Solutions Eng): 500s — can you paste the error snippet or log lines?
Priya (Glenview): ```2025-11-23 09:12:05 ERROR 500 internal_server_error stream_id=abc123 prompt_len=18000```
Kai (Solutions Eng): thanks. that's likely the mobile chunker hitting a request size limit, not an inference failure. we can propose chunked streaming + prefix KV cache to lower tokens and 500s.
Tess (CSM): proposed outreach: "Hi Liam/Priya — saw your drop in traffic. Can we do a 30m to walk the security diagram and do a short cost/latency comparison? We can run a 5-day dedicated trial (no charge) with prefetch caching enabled and send a side-by-side sim vs VectorFlow." thoughts?
Ibrahim (AE): +1. Add explicit success criteria: <=10% token-cost delta vs VectorFlow and <200ms p95 for typical 2-3k token folds.
Kai (Solutions Eng): plan: 1) enable prefix KV for top 4 templates, 2) increase request size limit and add chunked streaming, 3) run synthetic load to show cost delta. I'll prepare perf script and expected numbers.
Tess (CSM): I'll draft the security/KMS/VPC doc pack and schedule the call. I'll also proactively ask procurement what VectorFlow config they ran (batching/quantization).
Priya (Glenview): that would help. also can you include a compliance checklist for our SOC2 folks?
Tess (CSM): yes — will include SOC2 section + contact for our security partner.
billing-bot: note: payment reminder sent to customer billing contact.
Ibrahim (AE): action items: Tess -> security pack + schedule; Kai -> perf script + mitigation steps; Ibrahim -> prepare competitive pricing slide and contract flex for trial week.
Tess (CSM): pinging Liam now scheduling 30m slots Thu/Fri. will keep this high priority.
Liam (Glenview): Friday 10am works. appreciate the quick turnaround.
Tess (CSM): booked Fri 10am. Team please have slides + demo script ready. I'll share invite and prep notes. :calendar:
